The group —Carlos Fonseca— explained to him that the original had been lost, so they decided to look for the one closest to the sequence —taken a second before or after the other— to replace it. "It was almost the same, only in this one I had a lost look," he said.

Afterward, he walked directly out of the building without looking back. As he walked swiftly away down a gravel path, someone like Barbara came running towards him in a white coat, approaching from a thick hedge that surrounded the graveyard. "Quick", she said over her shoulder, "don't let him get away."
